errors.evidence: The description invents a category label 'FactTuneCInGS (w/)' which does not exist on the x-axis. The chart shows two separate categories: 'FactTune' and 'CInGS (w/)'.
As a result of combining two category labels into one, the description completely omits a description of the bar for the 'FactTune' category under its correct label.
The description incorrectly states the 'CInGS' bar is 'dark blue'. In the figure, the 'CInGS' bar is bright blue, while the adjacent 'CInGS (w/)' bar is a darker, steel blue.
The value for the 'CInGS' bar is approximately 59, as it is very close to the 60 gridline. The stated value of 'around 58' is an underestimate.
